method: Two first-frame sheets and two animation sheets visually inspected. Five animations sampled at four spaced positions, including all frames of MIKAPORTRAIT and QRNEEDLOVE. Longer animations not exhaustively reviewed. Source-specific comparison; shared artistic influence is not derivative evidence.
